subject: RE: [External] Data for Monday's Demo
text:
Dear Jennifer,

Good to hear that you received the data. The data with naming “cartesian_frame_...” is the 3D ultrasound image to process, there are 10 examples. The matching “bf_cartesian_seg_frame_...” is a coarse segmentation marking the general location of structures of interest. Currently, we use this as a guide for annotators to  recognise relevant anatomy and modify the labels “RA” (1) and “LA” (2).

Here is a screenshot of how the data looks in our annotation workflow:
[cid:image001.png@01DBC64A.CEC9E8E0]

I have also attached a data dictionary describing each label index. If you have any questions please let me know!

All the best,
Ivan

subject: Re: [External Sender] Re: Encord/Capital One follow Up
text:
Hi Alex,

Thank you for following up and your continued engagement.   I am
unfortunately unable to make a meeting today due to conflicts.

As we have reviewed your technical deployment materials, our engineering
team has not yet gained full clarity on the deployment process. I will
follow-up with the team on the materials you have provided to confirm your
update provides the clarity they were looking for.

Our Capital One supplier management team would work with Encord to
negotiate Proof of Concept contracts.  However, given the complexity of our
technical needs and also being in a regulated industry, it would be
important that our teams gain some confidence on the limitations and
constraints of technical deployment during the POC.  We'd also want to
assess this over a shorter/time-boxed period, say 30-60 days, not the 2
years which I believe was recommended by the Encord team.

Happy to discuss more to understand your constraints.

Thanks,
Ebony

subject: Re: Actuate sponsorship packages
text:
Great news! Excited to have you on board. 

 I'll send over the contract later this afternoon. Who would be the person to email on your side for signature? 

 As for speaking we have two options:

 Apply to speak

• 
Submit a presentation using the 'Apply to speak' button at the top of the website

• 
Presentation should be 15-18 minutes long, deeply technical, and focus in on a specific challenge area & solution of robotics development as it relates to scaling & production

• 
We typically prioritize engineers and technical individuals (working on the robot daily)

• 
examples can be found from last year on our youtube page: https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLzr0xSpP0YUF2bL9KW2lnYYe8Mg2clut- 

 Panel talk

• 
We will be hosting 3 different panel discussions this year. Early next month we will share the panel topics and people can apply to be a panelist

• 
Generally higher level robotics industry topics focusing on the latest developments, future trajectory/vision, and personal takes

• 
We typically prioritize individuals with industry experience, worked both as and engineer and leader, and people that have strong opinions

 Let me know what other questions you might have!

 Cheers,

 Sunny
